Rules.InvariantScript:
ColorFade(
    If(
        ThisItem.Score <= 3, gblColorRiskLow,
        ThisItem.Score <= 6, gblColorRiskModerate,
        ThisItem.Score <= 12, gblColorRiskHigh,
        gblColorRiskExtreme
    ),
    If(App.ActiveScreen = Dashboard && Coalesce(ThisItem.RiskCount, 0) = 0, 70%, 0%)
)

If(
    App.ActiveScreen <> Dashboard && ThisItem.Probability = varHighlightP && ThisItem.Severity = varHighlightS,
    2,
    0
)

If(
    ThisItem.Score <= 3, "Low",
    ThisItem.Score <= 6, "Moderate",
    ThisItem.Score <= 12, "High",
    "Extreme"
) & " · P" & ThisItem.Probability & " × S" & ThisItem.Severity

//If(Self.Layout = Layout.Horizontal, Min(320, Self.Width - 60), Min(320, Self.Height - 60))
btnCell.Width + 5
